rules.no_read_bench: Do not open, read, grep, list, or otherwise inspect anything under ./bench/; it contains evaluator-only ground truth and scoring code.
rules.read_full_book: Read book.txt completely from beginning to end before answering. The agent may choose any retrieval, read-range, summarization, or context-management strategy; no fixed read granularity is required. Read and search the original book.txt directly.
rules.no_temporary_files: Do not create temporary, scratch, or intermediate files anywhere, including the run directory, output/, /tmp, hidden directories, or system temp locations. Do not copy, split, extract, convert, compress, cache, or materialize book.txt or any part of it into another file, including chapter/section files or extracted-passage files. The only files the agent may create are the four required answer JSON files.
rules.answer_from_source: Use book.txt as the sole source of truth for answers. The agent may revisit or search the book as needed; retrieval strategy is not independently penalized.
rules.output_only: Do not modify book.txt, input/, or bench/. Write only the four required task answer files inside output/; keep any summaries in working context rather than writing intermediate files.
rules.no_agent_telemetry: Do not require agent-authored run or progress logs. Session/tool traces are the evaluator's source for observable run measurements.
rules.no_fabrication: Never invent facts. When a premise is unsupported by the book, say so in the answer string.
